Nearby Places & Attractions in Hubballi

Radiant Vista is centrally located on Gokul Road in Akshay Park, Hubballi, providing convenient access to shopping, transport terminals, leisure destinations, and important attractions around the city:

  • Inorbit Mall Hubballi

    Hubballi’s leading retail, dining, and family entertainment center, just minutes from the hotel (convenient for guests looking for a hotel near Inorbit Mall Hubballi or dining near Inorbit Mall).

  • Hubballi Airport (Gokul Road)

    The city's primary domestic airport, situated on the same Gokul Road corridor for effortless transit (ideal for travelers needing a hotel near Hubballi Airport).

  • Hubballi Junction (Railway Station)

    The central railway terminal for the South Western Railway zone, connecting Hubballi-Dharwad to major cities across India (perfect for visitors looking for a hotel near Hubballi Junction).

  • Unkal Lake

    A scenic 110-year-old recreational lake with lush parklands, boating facilities, and a grand statue of Swami Vivekananda.

  • Chandramouleshwara Temple

    An extraordinary 11th-century Western Chalukya architectural monument featuring intricate black granite stone carvings.

  • Nrupatunga Betta

    A popular elevated viewpoint offering sweeping vistas of the Hubballi-Dharwad cityscape, sunrise, and sunset.

  • Siddharoodha Math

    A historic spiritual institution and ashram founded in honor of Sri Siddharoodha Swami, attracting devotees and cultural travelers.

  • Indira Gandhi Glass House Garden

    A public horticultural park featuring a glass house modelled after London's Crystal Palace, hosting city flower shows and recreational walks.

Guests searching for a hotel on Gokul Road Hubballi, accommodation near Akshay Park, a business hotel near Hubballi Airport, or places to stay near Hubballi Junction enjoy premier accessibility and hospitality at Radiant Vista.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions About Radiant Vista Hubballi

Where is Radiant Vista hotel located in Hubballi?

Radiant Vista is located on Gokul Road, Akshay Park, Hubballi (also spelled Hubli), Karnataka 580030, India, near Hubballi Airport and Inorbit Mall Hubballi.

Is Hubballi the same city as Hubli?

Yes. Hubballi is the official Kannada name and Hubli is the common Anglicized spelling of the same city in northern Karnataka, which forms the twin city Hubballi-Dharwad.

Does Radiant Vista have an on-site restaurant?

Yes. Brick and Brew is the restaurant at Radiant Vista on Gokul Road, Hubballi, serving nostalgic food favourites with a modern twist in a vibrant setting.

Is there a rooftop bar at Radiant Vista in Hubballi?

Yes. Breeze Point is the rooftop bar and restaurant at Radiant Vista, offering an open-roof ambience, curated cocktails, savoury dishes, and panoramic skyline views.

Can I book a banquet hall for a wedding or corporate event at Radiant Vista?

Yes. Gala Vista offers two dedicated event spaces: Gala Vista I (Grand Banquet Hall) for weddings and receptions, and Gala Vista II (Conference & Event Space) for corporate conferences, seminars, and business meetings. Call +91 836 200 2487 or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com to check dates.

What room categories are available at Radiant Vista?

Radiant Vista offers Classic Rooms, Premium Rooms, and Suites, all equipped with individually controlled air conditioning, 42-inch Smart TVs, and business amenities.

Is Radiant Vista suitable for business travellers visiting Hubballi?

Yes. Radiant Vista is positioned as a business hotel on Gokul Road near Hubballi Airport, featuring a business center, meeting spaces, high-speed Wi-Fi, and 24/7 front desk services.

How do I book a room or reserve a table at Radiant Vista?

Call reservations at +91 91871 95517, call the front desk at +91 836 200 2487, email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com, or book online through hotelradiantvista.com.
